Run `/claude-api hillclimb` against the eval set you already have. It's the claude-api skill's subcommand for exactly this search: it tries cheaper models and lower effort settings, proposes prompt adjustments, and scores each candidate on your suite, applying a change to the bot only when you approve it.

Two cautions before you trust the winner. First, a configuration that scores 91% once may sit at 88% on the next run, so re-run the finalists a few times and prefer one with some margin above 90%. Second, prompt tuning against the same cases you score on can overfit; if your set is large enough, hold back a slice the search never sees and confirm the chosen configuration on it.
